ai.title: Split Search vs Agent system prompts
ai.summary: Refactored system prompt generation into getSearchSystemPrompt and getAgentSystemPrompt. Search prompt now contains only file tree and relevant files prompt part 1. Agent prompt includes file tree conditionally based on size (<40k chars) to save context. Updated main-prompt.ts and websocket-action.ts to use new functions.

eli5.text: The assistant now builds two different instruction sets instead of one: a smaller one for when it's searching through files to find the right ones, and a larger one for when it's actually doing the editing work. When starting a task, it sends only the file list and a note about relevant files; when doing the real work, it decides whether to include the full project file tree based on size, skipping it for very large projects to save context space. This only affects the backend system that assembles prompts for the assistant, so you wouldn't notice anything visually, but it helps the assistant work more efficiently on big codebases. The change is live today for all users.
